title: fix: token database has no entries for CAC cards, Feitian tokens, or generic PIV fallback
description:
wp11_token_db lists: YubiKey 5 (3 models), NitroKey HSM 2, NitroKey Pro 2. The CLAUDE.md states the target includes 'CAC/PIV cards, many Feitian tokens' but none of these appear in the table.

A token not in the table falls through to the 'unknown' path. If that path assigns proto=WP11_PROTO_PIV with no quirks, it may work — or it may fail silently with a token that needs WP11_QUIRK_SHORT_APDU or other handling.

Research and fix:
1. Add Feitian ePass3003 (0x096E:0x0608), FIDO K9 (0x096E:0x0858), and other common PIV-capable Feitian models
2. Add DoD CAC card ATR patterns (ATR-based matching if VID/PID is not available via USB — CAC cards may appear via CCID with a generic reader VID/PID)
3. Add a generic PIV fallback row: VID=0, PID=0, proto=WP11_PROTO_PIV, quirks=WP11_QUIRK_SHORT_APDU (conservative default — assume short APDU until extended APDU is confirmed to work)
4. Add WP11_QUIRK_EXTENDED_APDU flag and set it explicitly on tokens known to support extended APDUs (YubiKey 5, NitroKey HSM 2)
5. Document in CLAUDE.md how to add a new token row and what each quirk flag does

Add a comment above the table: 'Tokens not in this table are attempted as generic PIV with conservative quirks — see wp11_token_db_lookup_unknown() for fallback behavior.'
